description_en: Queries the SSL configurations of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的SSL配置情况
name: DescribeDBInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ACL.description_en:
The method that is used to verify the instance. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks.

cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL 12 or later)
ACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

CAType.description_en:
The type of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. Valid values:

aliyun: a cloud certificate
custom: a custom certificate
CAType.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书类型，返回值：
aliyun：使用云证书
custom：使用自定义证书

ClientCACert.description_en: The public key of the CA that issues client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
ClientCACert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥

ClientCACertExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the public key of the CA that issues client certificates expires. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and must be in UTC.

This parameter is not supported
ClientCACertExpireTime.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥有效期。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

暂不支持该参数，无需关注

ClientCertRevocationList.description_en: The certificate revocation list (CRL) that contains revoked client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
ClientCertRevocationList.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端吊销证书文件

ConnectionString.description_en: The endpoint that is protected by SSL encryption

ForceEncryption.description_en:
Indicates whether the [forceful SSL encryption]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html） feature is enabled. This parameter is supported only for RDS for SQL Server instances.

1: The feature is enabled.
0: The feature is disabled
ForceEncryption.description_zh:
SQL Server实例的[强制SSL加密功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html）是否已开启，返回值：

1：开启。
0：未开启

LastModifyStatus.description_en:
The status of the SSL link. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks.

success: The SSL link is successfully configured.
setting: The SSL link is being configured.
failed: The SSL link failed to be configured
LastModifyStatus.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态，返回值：

success：成功
setting：设置中
failed：失败

ModifyStatusReason.description_en: The reason why the SSL link stays in the current state. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
ModifyStatusReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态对应的原因

ReplicationACL.description_en:
The method that is used to verify the replication permission. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. Valid values:

cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL 12 or later)
ReplicationACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的replication权限认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

RequireUpdate.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate needs to be updated. Valid values:

An SSL certificate remains valid for one year. Before the used SSL certificate expires, you must update the validity period of the SSL certificate. If you do not update the validity period of the SSL certificate, your application or client that uses encrypted network connections cannot connect to your RDS instance.

RDS instances that run MySQL and SQL Server

No: The SSL certificate does not need to be updated.
Yes: The SSL certificate needs to be updated.

RDS instances that run PostgreSQL

0: The SSL certificate does not need to be updated.
1: The SSL certificate needs to be updated
RequireUpdate.description_zh:
是否需要更新SSL证书，返回值：

SSL证书有效期为1年，证书到期后不更新，会导致使用加密连接的客户端程序无法正常连接实例。
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

No：无需更新
Yes：需更新
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

0：无需更新
1：需更新

</details>

RequireUpdateItem.description_en: The server certificate that needs to be updated. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disk
RequireUpdateItem.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新的服务器证书列表

RequireUpdateReason.description_en: The reason why the server certificate needs to be updated. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
RequireUpdateReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新证书的原因

SSLCreateTime.description_en: The time when the server certificate was created. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. In addition, this parameter is valid only when the CAType parameter value is aliyun
SSLCreateTime.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书创建时间，当CAType配置为aliyun时有效

SSLEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL encryption is enabled. Valid values:

RDS instances that run MySQL and SQL Server

Yes: SSL encryption is enabled.
No: SSL encryption is disabled.

RDS instances that run PostgreSQL

on: SSL encryption is enabled.
off: SSL encryption is disabled
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
SSL的加密状态，返回值：
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

Yes：已开启
No：未开启
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

on：已开启
off：未开启

</details>

SSLExpireTime.description_en: The time when the SSL certificate expires. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and must be in UTC

ServerCAUrl.description_en: The URL of the certificate that is used to issue the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disk
ServerCAUrl.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例签发服务器证书的CA证书URL

ServerCert.description_en: The content of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
ServerCert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书内容

ServerKey.description_en: The private key of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks
ServerKey.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书私钥

TlsVersion.description_en: The [minimum Transport Layer Security (TLS) version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html）. Valid values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
TlsVersion.description_zh: SQL Server实例已指定的[最低LTS版本号]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html），当前支持1.0、1.1、1.2
